summary: Independent design re-review of amended frozen spec ce99472dd171f31697288d2153e12865c5c1a111a033f5135d4333d0462adddf and native regenerated context 708ec0ca7e97f6f58688ef28f4eae631d5f84798637eb3cba4a73a189469fbee. RF-001 is addressed in design by no-follow ancestry checks for .git and conservative HEAD plus objects/commondir bare structures. RF-002 is addressed in design by separating initial unsafe-root/mode rejection before task loading and directory creation from execution-time create/identity/leaf refusal before log creation or pytest launch, retaining necessary native local FAILED records and preserving old contents; CI retains its explicit read-only ledger constraint. The reviewed design preserves absence-of-option behavior, pure plan construction, full original Policy semantics, fixed five-check basetemp augmentation, deduplicated execution ownership, unchanged environment/selectors/budgets/85 and 90 percent thresholds, exact final checks/executions argv, evidence command/reproduce snapshot binding and runtime-free verifier context for finalize/CI. It explicitly bounds ordinary detectable races without claiming a same-user OS sandbox. Historical spec/context/first input were retained and checked. No further blocking design issue found. This approves the amended design only: no production or tests implemented by this reviewer, no new behavior or performance verified, no full V2 execution, implementation review, finalization or publication performed.
